name: zycode
description: Chat with the zycode coding agent in VS Code. Unofficial; not affiliated with pi or Microsoft.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: zycode runs an agent that reads and writes files and runs commands in your folder.

virtualWorkspaces.description: zycode runs a program on the machine that holds your folder. A virtual workspace has no such folder.

commands.title: Set up model and API key

zycode.agentPath.markdownDescription: Absolute path of a program (or a program name found on `PATH`) to run instead of the `zycode-agent` binary in this extension. Leave empty to use the bundled binary.

zycode.agentArgs.markdownDescription: Arguments for `#zycode.agentPath#`. For a Python install: path `python`, arguments `["-m", "pi_agent_cli"]`.

enumDescriptions: Ask before every action that is not read-only.
Run actions that are clearly in scope. Ask about the rest. Auto is not a sandbox: it guards what a call writes or runs, not what it reads or sends.
zycode.permissionMode.markdownDescription: The mode of a start: which tool calls the agent runs without asking. The extension sets it for each session through the `mode` option of the agent. It overrides `permission` in `agent.toml`, including `always-approve`. This setting offers `ask` and `auto` only: **Always approve** is chosen in the mode menu of the chat, after a warning, and it is never restored for a new chat or after a restart. An agent without a `mode` option keeps the mode of `agent.toml`. `auto` can send your messages and some `bash` commands to a model (see the README).

zycode.showThinking.description: Show the thinking blocks of the model in the chat (collapsed).

walkthroughs.title: Get started with zycode
walkthroughs.description: Open a folder, save a model and a key, and say hello. You can open this guide again at any time.

steps.title: Open a folder
steps.description:
zycode works in the folder that is open in VS Code. Open a folder that you trust.
[Open folder](command:workbench.action.files.openFolder)

steps.title: Choose a model and save your key
steps.description:
The setup asks for a provider, a model id and an API key in a terminal. The key stays in the agent's own folder.
[Run setup](command:zycode.runSetup)

steps.title: Say hello
steps.description:
Write a message in the zycode view.
[Open chat](command:zycode.openChat)

steps.title: Choose how much zycode asks
steps.description:
Ask, Auto or Always approve. A new chat starts in Ask or Auto.
[Open the setting](command:workbench.action.openSettings?%5B%22zycode.permissionMode%22%5D)

steps.title: Find your past chats
steps.description:
The Past chats list shows the chats of this folder. Select one to open it.
[Show past chats](command:zycode.sessions.focus)

steps.title: If something does not work
steps.description:
A key that is not accepted, a wrong model id, a server that cannot be reached.
[Open agent.toml](command:zycode.openAgentConfig)
[Show log](command:zycode.showLog)
